Honorable Governor Powes Parkop,
As a prominent Human Rights lawyer, you know the law better than anyone. It is therefore deeply hypocritical that you are now violating the fundamental rights of 13 million Papua New Guineans by championing the Vagrancy Act. This bill effectively turns our own people into refugees within their own country. Before pushing this "stupidity bill" any further, you must acknowledge that you are obliterating the Human Rights set by the UN and the Commonwealth—specifically the constitutional freedoms of movement and speech.
Furthermore, the City Warden program appears to be a massive scam designed to defraud the 1 billion Kina commission fund meant for the people of NCD. Specifically, the 17 million Kina budget set aside for the City Wardens is allegedly being siphoned through a series of "management fees":
Funds move from the NCD City Hall account to City Security.
They are then transferred to Sengal Parkop (Blitz) under the guise of management fees.
Only then do they reach the City Warden account, where workers are paid in cash rather than through official bank accounts.
This is a blatant operation by the Governor, his family, and associates to exploit the NCD People’s Office. We demand that the Ombudsman Commission, the Fraud Squad, ICAC, and Transparency International launch an immediate investigation and arrest those involved in this corruption. Accountability is not optional!
